results.title: IRL (In Real Life)
results.overview: Two friends, a domestic worker and a beautician, log into the BGMI combat game daily where they slip briefly out of their real lives. Through their avatars, they explore different selves, anonymity and intimacy inside the virtual world of the game, as the battlefield becomes as much about companionship and transgression, as it is about thrill. The docu-fiction explores how players reimagine their bodies and construct personas, revealing a landscape of desire and performance.

results.title: The Beast in Me
results.overview: A man has something to hide from his date.

results.title: Postum
results.overview: In a Romanian village, families gather to remember their dead through memorial rituals held at specific intervals after a person’s death.

results.title: Flocked Mallard Male
results.overview: In a series of accounts, two men question why the woman they have both dated left them. With no answers, they eventually find common ground rooted in misogyny.

results.title: a pink and red dress, made of satin… covered in flowers, mostly roses
results.original_title: a pink and red dress, made of satin… covered in flowers, mostly roses
results.overview: Elsa remembers her mother truly happy only when she was singing. As a child, she and her twin brother would secretly watch her perform at The Little Onne Theatre. Now grown, Elsa sings on the same stage, in the same flower-covered dress her mother once wore.

results.title: ReLive
results.overview: A freak temporal anomaly erases her son from existence, a grieving mother is recruited for an impossible mission: travel back twenty years in her own timeline to a college hiking trip to kill the inventor of time travel to save her son.

results.title: We'll Be Ghosts
results.overview: Haunted by the recent loss of his daughter, Ukrainian soldier Yuri refuses to take leave and return home from the front line. Hiding his thirst for vengeance behind silence and his grief behind duty, he volunteers for a dangerous operation. But when duty, vengeance and survival collide and the mission spirals out of control, Yuri has to face the cost of what he’s become.

results.title: The Fencing Tournament
results.overview: At the final match of a fencing tournament, Anja watches her son lose to one of his friends. When his rivalry turns into racism and violence, she becomes the only witness to what truly happened. Torn between shame, ambition and the fear of admitting the truth, Anja finds herself caught in a profound moral conflict.

results.title: Do Not Be Afraid
results.overview: A transgender woman miraculously becomes pregnant with the second coming of Christ.

results.title: To the Last Drop
results.overview: Plagued by nightmares, Joel is handed an impossible assignment. The Boss wants a new fix, but in the ruined world there is nothing left to collect. Wandering across the apocalyptic wasteland, Joel stumbles upon sunburnt Maarit, who decides to tag along. Back at HQ, The Boss, wracked by withdrawal, gives Joel an earful, while Maarit unexpectedly takes matters into her own hands.

results.title: There Is Something I Want to Tell You
results.overview: Following a recent act of terrorism, growing homophobia among those around Jaro leaves him feeling increasingly cornered. The situation threatens the identity he has kept hidden.

results.title: Bye Bye
results.overview: Henry decided to end his life by hanging himself. He planned everything carefully, but miscalculated one thing: when he sat down to write his suicide note, he suddenly discovered that his pen had run out of ink.

results.title: Nika's Room
results.overview: Jakob, a single father by day and sex worker by night, watches his teenage daughter Nika losing herself in the frenzy of nightlife. The more Nika rebels against him, the more desperately Jakob seeks comfort and validation from his client Martha.

results.title: Prudence and the Wandering Eye
results.overview: In a strange, purgatory-like room where workers exchange small bundles for coins, Prudence notices an elderly blind woman waiting in line. She offers to help, but her seemingly good deed soon takes an unexpected turn.

results.title: Terra Firme
results.overview: In a coastal village forgotten by time, young Juca approaches Zé Cangulo, a fisherman living in isolation on his boat. A silent bond forms between them, shaped by waiting and the sea. By bringing to light a submerged past in which the boy recognizes himself, this encounter opens up the possibility of a fresh start.

results.title: Ember
results.overview: Young Dalai, aspiring to follow in his injured brother’s footsteps, trains relentlessly for the Naadam Fair to save their horse from being sold. Despite his father’s doubts and the weight of family struggles, Dalai faces emotional challenges, balancing family expectations with his own dreams and ultimately forging his own path through the deep bond between man and horse.

results.title: Other's Meadows Flowers
results.overview: When her younger sister Róża mysteriously disappears, Morwa begins searching for her and recalls the last moments they spent together.

results.title: The Last Ally
results.overview: Poland, spring 1945. In a landscape suspended between the end of the war and the beginning of uncertainty, two survivors meet: a Polish prisoner on the run and a young German deserter.

results.title: The Lacey Way
results.overview: Teenage George Lacey does not fit in. She’s a weirdo amongst her conforming peers and a conformist amongst her weirdo family. Only the cows are kind to her. The real world calls to George. Tonight she answers.

results.title: The Gloom
results.overview: A social worker witnesses some disturbing events. She decides to trust her intuition and find answers to the questions that trouble her.
